summary: Customer clarity, test-result interpretation, social identity and presentation sync

presentation.approval: User explicitly approved saving all 22 revised slide previews.

social.footer: Three accessible non-interactive platform marks; user supplied no profile URLs.

learnings.title: Customer language before technical detail
learnings.learning: Fine-lines and dark-spots empathy now sits in the homepage introduction.
learnings.recommendation: Use recognisable customer concerns as brand-authored copy, then connect to daily UV protection and a practical next step.
learnings.limits: Copy hypothesis; customer quotations remain exact and attributed. Conversion impact is unmeasured.

learnings.title: Translate product testing into everyday decisions
learnings.learning: Protection, patch assessment and hydration cards now explain what each result means to the customer.
learnings.recommendation: Lead with benefit and action, retain the figures, participants, methods and linked sources.
learnings.limits: Manufacturer-published results apply to the linked formula. Comfort signals do not guarantee suitability for every person.

learnings.title: Hydration readings do not determine SPF duration
learnings.learning: Added a direct FAQ explaining why hydration results do not remove reapplication.
learnings.recommendation: Keep a simple morning routine and clear outdoor reapplication guidance together.
learnings.limits: Reapply approximately every two hours outdoors and after swimming or sweating, following the label.

learnings.title: Specific coastal guidance builds clearer environmental understanding
learnings.learning: Added coastal-care guidance explaining ingredient-list context and protective habits.
learnings.recommendation: Use specific ingredient facts, clothing, shade and destination guidance rather than blanket ecosystem claims.
learnings.limits: Absence of oxybenzone and octinoxate alone does not prove the complete formula is reef-safe.

learnings.title: Quote attribution needs its own layout block
learnings.learning: Fixed the line crossing the homepage review by removing an inherited attribution border and displaying the source on a separate line.
learnings.recommendation: Keep shared source-note styles scoped to their context; visually check desktop and mobile.
learnings.limits: Browser verification showed a zero-width attribution top border. Exact review wording was preserved.

learnings.title: Social identity without invented destinations
learnings.learning: Added labelled Facebook, Instagram and TikTok marks to all 26 page footers.
learnings.recommendation: Keep marks non-interactive until actual profile URLs are available.
learnings.limits: User confirmed no actual accounts exist. No dead links or live-account claims were added.

learnings.title: Proposed social launch previews
learnings.learning: Created Instagram, Facebook and TikTok page mockups and saved them in the presentation.
learnings.recommendation: Connect each preview to a customer question and a relevant website next step.
learnings.limits: Proposed launch previews only; no accounts, fabricated follower counts or engagement statistics.

learnings.title: Keep the deck aligned with the built website
learnings.learning: Updated 22 slides, five persona journeys, 26-page navigation, 52 FAQ answers in eight groups and eight dated review excerpts.
learnings.recommendation: Maintain a single content ledger when the site grows, preserving teammates' current persona work.
learnings.limits: Persona scenarios are planning hypotheses. Current checks verify structure and links, not rankings, indexing or conversion.

validation.lighthouse: Not rerun for this update; no current perfect-score claim.
